event_name: Date 07 July 2018 Time 15:14 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards have received a request from Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda to re-scrutineer car 28 which has had a change of the survival cell. In accordance with Article 25.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards agreed that this can take place on July 8th before 12:00hrs Local Time. Further, in accordance with Art 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards have determined that car 28 has set suitable times during the free practice sessions and will therefore be permitted to start. However, in accordance with Art 23.2 the car will be required to start the race from the pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 25.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Doc 25 2018 British Grand Prix Decision Car 28 Change Of Survival Cell
